headings.usage: Use for stat numbers and main headers. Apply tracking-tight. NEVER use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Highly legible for tables, inputs, and dense data views.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #e2e8f0 on white cards. No borders on the dark background.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use shadow-lg on white cards to make them pop against the slate background.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-md for buttons, badges, and inputs.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. KPI cards take 1 column, charts take 2 columns.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 inside white cards. Maintain gap-6 between cards.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Desktop: Collapsible sidebar with #1e293b background. Mobile: Fixed bottom nav with #ffffff background and slate icons.

components.stat_cards: White background, big slate numbers, safety orange Lucide icons.
components.tables: Shadcn JS table. White background, simple borders, striped rows in #f8fafc for readability.
components.buttons: Rounded-md. Primary: bg-[#ea580c] text-white hover:bg-[#c2410c]. Secondary: outline or ghost.
components.badges: Pill-shaped. Use for status (Paid/Pending/Overdue) and Roles. bg-opacity-20 with bold text.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text has sufficient contrast. Use #0f172a for text on white cards.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings on inputs and buttons using focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#ea580c] focus:outline-none.
accessibility.data_testid: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard exactly as a high-contrast layout: overall page body has background #1e293b, but main content containers/cards are crisp white (#ffffff).
Implement 5 core modules: Main Dashboard, Cash Flow Tracker, Employee Management & Payroll, Construction Planner, Document Storage.
Use standard JS files for React components, no TypeScript (.tsx). Generate guidelines for .js.
Use Recharts for charts: Revenue vs Expenses (Bar/Line), Expense Breakdown (Donut).
Use Lucide-React for icons: HardHat, DollarSign, Calendar, TrendingUp, Users, Trash2, Edit3.
Currency formatting MUST use ₹ (Indian Rupee) instead of $.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`).
Do not center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, specific transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Ensure layout is mobile-responsive with appropriate overflow handling.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, or dropdowns.
